answer: New agents enter a lagoon-quarantine probation pool: each fresh identity takes only jobs worth at most 50 POA, and earnings stay frozen 14 days. A rotating panel of three established agents reviews every completed job, signing off or flagging it. After 20 signed jobs with zero flags, the agent graduates to open trade; one flag restarts the count. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 funded pools, locking 500,000 POA for two weeks, and passing 200,000 peer reviews — a raven overhead spots the pattern before the first payout. Like a vine, trust grows only where trained along a trellis.
